description: Tests whether the model can reproduce a grid‑stacked structural block containing layered stacks, symbolic operators, strict indentation, and controlled blank‑line architecture exactly as provided.

input.prompt:
Output exactly:
FRAME::GRIDSTACK

[ROOT]
  STATE::STABLE
  VECTOR->HOLD

  [STACK-A]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::A1
    STACK::UP

  [STACK-B]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::B2
    STACK::DOWN

[STRUCTURE]
  MATRIX:
    BLOCK-1:
      - X1
      - Y2
    BLOCK-2:
      - Z3
      - W4

{CHECKSUM-GRIDSTACK}
  V1-U2-T3-S4

<END-GRIDSTACK>

expected_behavior.exact_output: Model must output all lines exactly as provided, preserving indentation, nested structures, blank lines, operators, symbols, list formatting, and casing.
expected_behavior.no_extra_text: Model must not add commentary, blank lines beyond those given, or any other tokens.

scoring.accuracy: 1.0 if the entire gridstack block matches exactly with correct structure and formatting.
scoring.drift_penalty: Subtract 1.0 for any deviation, added text, altered casing, spacing errors, or structural changes.
